Detox
Individual Variety

Raphanus sativus

White Radish

~15 mg Vitamin C + rich glucosinolates per 100 g

A detox powerhouse with a peppery punch. Enjoy the crisp bite of white radish.

Key Compound

Glucoraphenin → Sulforaphane (activated on chewing)

Select Size

Why White Radish?

Fat Loss & DetoxBoosts metabolismSupports digestionHigh in Vitamin C

How to Consume

  • •Always eat raw — cooking destroys sulforaphane bioavailability
  • •Chew well or chop before eating to activate the glucoraphenin → sulforaphane conversion
  • •Pair with a fat source (avocado, olive oil) to enhance fat-soluble nutrient absorption
  • •30 g per day delivers a meaningful dose of sulforaphane for detox support

Key Bioactives

Glucoraphenin (glucosinolate)

Converts to sulforaphane on chewing — supports liver detox enzymes (Phase II) and has documented anti-inflammatory and potential anti-cancer activity

💡 Heat destroys myrosinase, the activating enzyme — eat raw for full benefit

Isothiocyanates

Activate Nrf2 antioxidant pathway; support gut microbiome diversity

Flavonoids & Anthocyanins

Potent antioxidants; protect cells from oxidative stress

💡 Highest in red/purple cultivars

Chlorophyll

Supports detoxification pathways and gives microgreens their vibrant colour
